questions.stem: A point $(5, -3)$ is reflected in the line $x = 2$. What are the coordinates of the image?
questions.explanation: The point $(5, -3)$ is $5 - 2 = 3$ units to the right of the line $x = 2$. Reflecting moves it 3 units to the left of the line: $2 - 3 = -1$. The $y$-coordinate stays the same, giving $(-1, -3)$.

questions.stem: Shape $A$ is reflected in the $x$-axis to give shape $B$. Shape $B$ is then reflected in the $y$-axis to give shape $C$. What single transformation maps $A$ to $C$?

options.text: A reflection in the line $y = x$
A rotation of $180°$ about the origin

questions.explanation: Reflecting in the $x$-axis maps $(x, y) \to (x, -y)$. Then reflecting in the $y$-axis maps $(x, -y) \to (-x, -y)$. The combined effect $(x, y) \to (-x, -y)$ is a rotation of $180°$ about the origin.
